title: Switching tabs ends bulk mode and clears the ticked rows
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWITCH-01 and -02) are active at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory parts {Part-C} and {Part-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWITCH-03 and -04) are inactive at {Location-A}.
  • All four part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SWITCH).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Click the {Part-B} row.
  7. Click the Inactive tab.
  8. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  9. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  10. Click Activate parts.
  11. Click the {Part-C} row.
  12. Click the Active tab.
  13. Click the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The bulk bar reads "2 selected" and the {Part-A} and {Part-B} rows are ticked.
  • Step 7: The Inactive tab opens with no bulk bar and no checkbox column: bulk mode has ended and nothing is ticked.
  • Step 8: The Inactive tab lists {Part-C} and {Part-D}, without checkboxes.
  • Step 11: The bulk bar reads "1 selected" and the {Part-C} row is ticked.
  • Step 12: The Active tab shows no bulk bar and no checkboxes, and {Part-A} and {Part-B} are still listed (nothing changed status).
  • Step 13: The Inactive tab shows no bulk bar and no checkboxes, and {Part-C} is listed and not ticked.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-R6, S2-R16, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.2 (Mode on), board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), 13 Oct copy. Story SV-11040 (Verify Phase 3) checklist. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R6: “Switching tabs clears any rows the user had ticked.”
  • S2-R16: “Switching between the Active and Inactive tabs ends the mode and clears the selection.”
  • SV-11040 verification checklist (Verify Phase 3): “Ticks survive sort; switching tabs clears them”
